_timing: No narration yet. Each beat is the larger of the time it needs to finish animating and the time it takes to read, plus a 22-frame hold. This is a floor, not considered pacing — measure a real read and switch this topic to voiceCuts.

beats.text: That number came from a book about mental images.
beats.note: Maxwell Maltz's 1960 book Psycho-Cybernetics said it takes a minimum of about 21 days for a mental image to change, drawing on plastic surgery recovery and phantom limbs.

beats.name: Phillippa Lally and colleagues, UCL
beats.role: 96 volunteers picked a new daily habit, such as eating fruit with lunch, and rated how automatic it felt over 84 days.

beats.context: The average time for a habit to feel automatic. Individuals ranged from 18 days to a forecast 254.

beats.note: The study stopped at 84 days, so the longest time was projected, not observed.
One missed day had little effect on later progress. Many missed days, added up, lowered how automatic the habit became.

beats.text: Roughly two months, with a very wide range.

beats.line: Give a habit time, and forgive the odd miss.
